label: Last checked at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Dave Portnoy Backs Rory McIlroy
items.text: Dave Portnoy supports Rory McIlroy's criticism of Bryson DeChambeau as "performative" and justifies DeChambeau's two-shot penalty at The Open for improving his backswing area.

items.headline: Rory McIlroy Pauses Until FedEx St. Jude
items.text: Rory McIlroy announced he will not compete again until the FedEx St. Jude Championship due to losing excitement in the PGA Tour and needing a top-30 FedExCup ranking to contend.
